name: text-diff
title: Text Diff
description: Compares two strings: unified or split, line numbers, unchanged regions folded behind Expand N lines, changed words highlighted, syntax colours by language, word wrap, line selection and find in page; inputs past 200k characters diff in a Web Worker.
docs: `<TextDiff oldText newText language="tsx" />` takes the diff options (`algorithm`, `context`, `ignoreWhitespace`, `worker`, `workerThreshold`) and every DiffView prop. Small inputs diff during render; large ones in a worker, with `loading` shown before the first result and `aria-busy` while a newer one computes.
